title: Code and data for: Manufacturer-Level and Drug-Level Shocks on the U.S. Drug Shortage List: Identification, Persistence and Supplier Redundancy

creators.name: Kumar, Om
creators.affiliation: Green Level High School, Cary, NC, USA

creators.name: Salwekar, Ishaan
creators.affiliation: Green Level High School, Cary, NC, USA

description: Python code, raw public FDA exports (openFDA drug shortages, NDC Directory and enforcement; Orange Book; FDA Data Dashboard inspection classifications) and processed tables that reproduce every number, table and figure of the paper 'Manufacturer-Level and Drug-Level Shocks on the U.S. Drug Shortage List: Identification, Persistence and Supplier Redundancy' (Kumar and Salwekar, submitted to MDPI Logistics). The 130 Internet Archive captures of the FDA Drug Shortage Database CSV are pinned by Wayback timestamp and SHA-256 in data/raw/archive_csv/manifest.csv and re-downloaded by download_archive_csv.py.
